mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return as recession risks rise within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), the Federal Reserve's policy rate (FEDFUNDS) is elevated, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, as measured by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 99.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate a severe demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 60 trading days as economic weakness deepens.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the concurrent weakness in payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals a labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
